escalation.rationale: Multi-theater escalation persists: Iran-US conflict expands with strikes on US-contracted ships and documented base damage, Houthi drone near Mecca triggers Saudi strikes on Yemen, Russia plots assassinations on US soil and continues drone strikes killing civilians in Ukraine, while Poland warns of Russian plans to strike NATO allies.

ticker_items: Houthi drone intercepted near Mecca; Saudi warplanes strike Yemen in response.
Iran strikes US-contracted ship with American personnel aboard.
Russia drones kill 5 on Ukrainian bus and train in southern Ukraine.
DOJ indicts Russian agents for plotting attacks inside the United States.
Ukraine drone strike reportedly kills decorated Russian general.

eastern_europe.description: Russian drones struck a passenger bus and a train in southern Ukraine, killing five civilians.
Russia launched an attack in western Ukraine near the Polish border, prompting Poland to scramble military aircraft.
Greenpeace investigation finds Russia is sabotaging power supply lines at the Zaporizhzhia nuclear power plant.
Ukrainian forces reportedly killed a decorated Russian general in a drone strike, according to unverified reports.

middle_east.description: Saudi air defenses intercepted a Houthi drone south of Mecca; Saudi Arabia declared the holy city a 'red line'.
Saudi warplanes pounded Yemen following the alleged Houthi drone attack near Mecca.
Houthi fighters launched drones and missiles at Saudi cities in retaliation for Saudi airstrikes on Yemen.
Houthis claimed to have shot down a Saudi F-15 fighter jet, releasing video footage of the alleged shootdown.
Iran struck a US-contracted ship with American personnel on board, further heightening US-Iran tensions.

today.incident: Russian drone strikes on bus and train, southern Ukraine
Russian general killed in Ukrainian drone strike

claimed_totals.claim: US base buildings damaged or destroyed — Iran strikes

russia.title: Russian Foreign Minister

middle_east.speaker: Abbas Araghchi
middle_east.title: Iranian Foreign Minister

middle_east.speaker: Houthi Representatives
middle_east.title: Houthi Delegation, Oman Talks

observers.description: Germany deployed Eurofighter jets to Latvia amid a drone threat during Latvian elections, reinforcing NATO's eastern flank. Berlin is also establishing a drone defense research center following an earlier incident in Leipzig.

Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi met Iranian counterpart Araghchi in Beijing, pressing Iran to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and return to the June MOU with the United States. China is visibly attempting to mediate economic stability while protecting its energy interests.

The US is actively engaged in military operations against Iran under Operation Epic Fury targeting nuclear sites and ballistic missile infrastructure. Simultaneously, the DOJ indicted Russian agents for plotting attacks on US soil, and the Trump administration is advancing a $2.8B arms sale to Israel.

North Korea continues drafting soldiers for deployment with Russian forces, with troops crossing the Tumen River bridge into Russia. Pyongyang also conducted a firepower attack drill showcasing new combat systems including advanced drones.

Saudi Arabia has engaged in direct military exchanges with the Houthis following the alleged drone attack near Mecca, striking Yemen with warplanes while its cities face Houthi drone and missile attacks. The escalation is disrupting the Saudi oil network and straining European energy supply.

Poland scrambled military jets in response to a Russian attack in western Ukraine near its border and publicly warned that Russian plans may include strikes against Ukraine's NATO allies. Warsaw's posture is increasingly defensive amid heightened threat perception.

financial.notes: The US Fed raised interest rates 25 basis points — its first hike in three years — as the Iran war's $38bn cost, diesel shock from Russian and Persian Gulf disruptions, and Saudi oil pipeline damage threaten European energy supply and global inflation.

Houthis claimed shootdown of Saudi F-15 fighter jet with video footage released.
DOJ indicted five Russian intelligence operatives for a $40,000 assassination plot targeting a Kremlin critic in Washington DC.

Ukrainian forces reportedly killed a decorated Russian general in a drone strike.
Russian drones struck a passenger bus and train in southern Ukraine, killing five civilians.
